title: Novel dual-network-structured hydrogel microspheres for efficient atmospheric water collection
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9546-9554
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08736D, Paper
Open Access

Kai Chen, Shijie Han, Shangsheng Zhang, Hongmei Du, Zhengzhi Zhang, Jian Wang, Xunkai Luo, Yulian Li
CA/PDMAPS/CNT/LiCl hydrogel microspheres capture water molecules at night and release adsorbed water by solar desorption drive during the day. The collected water can be used for domestic use and agricultural irrigation.
